correctness.rationale: The assigned source proves an exact cyclic one-letter move formula for all distinct letter pairs: C_xy(F_(i+1)^m)-C_xy(F_i^m)=m(A_x [u_i=y]-A_y [u_i=x]); summing yields m(A_x v_y-A_y v_x). Repeated-letter pairs depend only on the fixed full-period letter counts. Because each occurring letter has A_x>0, all mixed differences vanish exactly when v_x/A_x is constant, equivalently H_i=H_j for H_i(x)=p P_i(x)-i A_x. The p=1 and one-letter cases are vacuous but consistent. For m>=1 the factor m never changes equality. Bezout on reduced composition A/g implies collision distance is a multiple of p/g. For q>=3 distinct single-letter runs, any proper segment meeting all q labels contains an entire interior run, contradicting required strict proportionality; the one-binomial deck stays constant. The O(pq) expected integer-arithmetic grouping bound follows by forming p prefix vectors of dimension q, with hashing; bit complexity is not claimed. Recomputed the original seven-entry Git tree from actual source blob SHAs, obtaining 72caaec1601d35d1f8637145119b45cb6bc74740. Independently enumerated full scattered-pair decks for 2,970 words with alphabets of 1..4 letters, 111,585 phase pairs across m=1..3, 498,552 exact pair-count difference scaling checks and 1,344 grouped-run vectors for q=3..5; all agree with the theorem. These finite checks supplement rather than prove the universal equations.
